2124612272375185756.en_summary: @scottmelker asks if there is a fix for $BTC's quantum risk. Ran Neuner sees a quantum threat in the foreseeable future and does not think anyone will save Bitcoin because its developers cannot agree on a solution. He holds a lot of Bitcoin as an insurance policy and due to emotional attachment, and is less excited now as technology moves very fast.
2124612272375185756.zh_summary: @scottmelker 詢問是否有修復$BTC量子風險的方法。Ran Neuner認為可預見未來存在量子威脅，不認為有人會拯救比特幣，因為其開發者無法就解決方案達成一致。他持有大量比特幣作為保險政策和情感依戀，現在較不興奮，因為技術發展非常快。
